capacity.boundary_refinement: Tested five after four GO/six NO_GO rather than assuming a physical-core-to-instance mapping

eight_resource_block_preserved.reason: Six-instance pool mean 0.8553049645375077 exceeds prospective 0.85 headroom rule; 8 requires six resource pass

implementation.inference_scope: Local probe dispatcher and every sampled CLI thread on 7,15. Existing model backend is remote; its processors/weights are not controlled or counted as a local model.
implementation.mechanism: Linux sched_setaffinity per owned process thread plus inherited/taskset launch masks, not system-wide cpusets
implementation.minecraft_scope: Java/Netty/GC/render threads, Blockwire BCL worker/monitor threads, owned Prism and Xephyr/supervisor
implementation.os_spare_pair: Not used by benchmark processes; unrestricted background/OS work may run anywhere
implementation.sampling: About once per second. Exact UID/cwd/start-time proof required before any owned-thread affinity change; caller/other-service changes rejected.
implementation.startup_caveat: Some initial Java threads had broader masks despite inherited affinity (retained proof). All threads were corrected and verified before native connection/world measurement. No observed escape in measurement; affinity is not an adversarial sandbox.

limitations: Affinity is not exclusive reservation: system/background processes remain unrestricted; reported core utilization includes them
Small-sample/readiness capacity is not a universal hardware maximum or long-term autonomous reliability
Six was close to the prospective headroom boundary and functionally passed; the boundary was not relaxed after observation
Eight and sixteen not qualified, no 16-agent gameplay launched
Startup mask correction was needed before measurement; kernel affinity is checked, not a hard security cpuset
Only BCL camera actions were added to the resource workload, not concurrent mining/walking/crafting acceptance
Model probes ran during active-world/observe measurements; camera probes occur later in the same phase, not guaranteed to overlap the model requests

prospective_gates.cpu_denominator: Twelve logical SMT siblings of six physical MC cores, not the whole 16-thread host
prospective_gates.per_core_mean: Mean busy fraction of the two SMT siblings; not a claim of doubled physical throughput or exclusive CPU ownership
prospective_gates.percentiles: Nearest-rank ceil(p*n); RPC p50/p95/p99 all reported, p95 observe is the admission rule

qualification.scope: Observed readiness, bounded existing-runtime camera BCL and short remote-model probes under prospective headroom criteria, not 30-minute Survival

resource_summary.inference_latency_includes: CLI startup, network, remote service and local parsing; not separated forward-pass latency
resource_summary.local_model: Remote provider; no local weights loaded. CLI/dispatcher memory and CPU measured
resource_summary.model_tail_sample_size: Four requests per phase; p95/p99 are small-sample extrema, not a service SLA
resource_summary.ram_metrics: Summed Java/aux/monitor RSS can double-count mappings; host MemAvailable and swap independently measured
resource_summary.rendered_fps_and_exact_server_mspt: NOT_INSTRUMENTED; native ticks/game-time are reported separately
